titulo: Schedule with a gate: the channel runs on its own, you decide
hero_alt: A wall calendar with early-morning markings and a phone showing a warning message.
lead: The schedule turns the pipeline into a channel: one run a day, at a fixed time, without you having to remember. But a schedule without a gate just posts the wrong thing faster. In this lesson you write the timer, decide what happens on a day with no topic, and run a week approving every video, until the rejections stop.
objetivo: write your channel's schedule and run a week with manual approval, turning every rejection into a rule.

aprende.t: The three messages: video, no topic, failed
The week with a gate, and when to remove it

secoes.sub: Click each block. This is what happens every night in a radar.

nos.detalhe: The systemd timer (under your user) fires the run at the set time. In finviral: Monday to Friday at 02:00 the daily, Saturday the weekly, Sunday the one for next week.
Before anything else, the run checks pular.txt. A line with the date and the mode skips that run without turning off the schedule: holiday, trip, sensitive topic.
Collection, base, script, check, avatar, and video: lessons 3 to 5 running on their own. If the script has no material, SEM_PAUTA.txt comes out and the run ends there.

In the first week, nothing goes live without your approval. Every rejection is noted with the reason and becomes a rule in regras.md. Only after 3 days in a row without a rejection should you think about removing the gate from a step.
Every run ends with a message on Telegram: the video (with the link), "no topic", or "failed at X". Silence is never an answer: if nothing arrived, something got stuck before the notice.

secoes.volta: Every rejection becomes a rule; the next run already reads it
secoes.legenda: Each radar runs at a different time (02:00, 05:00, 08:00) so they don't compete for the GPU and the avatar studio.

secoes.sub: The finviral model, for you to adapt.

texto: 40 to 60 seconds with what the references posted yesterday and the day before.
90 s to 2 min with the week's recap. On the radars, a long 16:9 video, "The week explained", of 5 to 7 minutes comes out with it.
About 90 s covering what the references expect for next week.
Write down beforehand what happens on a day with no topic: no video, and the "sem pauta" message with the reason. Forcing a video on a slow day is the first step toward publishing the wrong thing.

exemplo.texto: sem pauta: none of the channels published a new video in the period.

secoes.sub: A systemd timer under your user (finviral uses it this way). Replace <canal> and the script path.

blocos.conteudo:
[Unit]
Description=<canal> — diario às 02:00

[Timer]
OnCalendar=Mon..Fri *-*-* 02:00:00
Persistent=false

[Install]
WantedBy=timers.target

[Unit]
Description=<canal> — rodada diario
After=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/bin/bash %h/projetos/<canal>/auto/rodar.sh diario
TimeoutStartSec=10h
MemoryMax=60G
Nice=5

systemctl --user daemon-reload
systemctl --user enable --now <canal>-diario.timer
systemctl --user list-timers '<canal>-*'

# skip one round without turning off the schedule
echo "2026-10-17 diario" >> auto/pular.txt

# minute hour day month day-of-week  command
0 2 * * 1-5  /bin/bash $HOME/projetos/<canal>/auto/rodar.sh diario

abas.html: With Persistent=false, a missed round (machine off at 02:00) does not run late when the machine comes back. For a daily radar, yesterday's video published in the afternoon is no use.

TimeoutStartSec and MemoryMax are limits: a round that hangs gets shut down, and one that bloats doesn't take the machine down with it. A round with no limit that hangs at 02:00 is still hanging at 09:00.

secoes.sub: Run the week. Interrupt it halfway and run it again.

msg.inicio: 5 rounds on the schedule. Click "Run the week".
msg.rodando: Each round: collection, base, script, check, and its gate.
msg.parou: Interrupted: the middle round didn't finish. On the next run it starts over; the ones that already went out aren't redone.
msg.retoma: Resumed: what was already approved isn't redone.
msg.fimfalha: Wednesday had no topic: no video, and the bot received "sem pauta". A slow day doesn't become a video.

secoes.legenda: Illustrative simulation in the browser. The Wednesday with no topic is on purpose, to show that an empty day is a normal result, not an error.

secoes.titulo: Practice: schedule and week with a gate

exercicios.texto: Decide how often it runs and write the schedule (systemd timer or cron), including what happens on a day with no topic and where the failure alert goes.
exercicios.pronto: the schedule is written, list-timers (or the crontab) shows the next run, and you know what happens on a day with no topic.

exercicios.texto: Run a week with manual approval before every post. Write down what you rejected and why; each rejection becomes a rule in regras.md.
exercicios.pronto: you went 3 days in a row without having to reject anything. Only then think about removing the gate from any step.

secoes.sub: The explanation appears after your answer.

perguntas.p: When is it reasonable to remove the gate from a step?
opcoes: Never: the gate is required everywhere.
After 3 days in a row without having to reject anything.
When the channel passes a thousand subscribers.
In the first week, to save time.
perguntas.explica: E6 asks for three days in a row with no rejections. Before that, the gate is still teaching the channel new rules.

perguntas.p: At 9 a.m. you haven't received anything from the bot. What does that mean?
opcoes: That it was a day with no topic.
That the video went out and there was no need to notify you.
That something got stuck before the alert: every run ends with a video, "sem pauta" or "falhou em X".
perguntas.explica: Silence is never an answer. A day with no topic sends "sem pauta"; a failure sends "falhou em X". If nothing arrived, check the run.

perguntas.p: Tomorrow is a holiday and you don't want a video. What can you do without turning off the schedule?
opcoes: Let it go out and delete it later.
Delete the timer and create it again later.
Put the date and the mode in pular.txt.
perguntas.explica: A line like "2026-10-17 diario" in pular.txt skips only that run.

perguntas.p: Why Persistent=false on the timer of a daily radar?
opcoes: So a missed run doesn't run late, publishing yesterday's radar in the afternoon.
perguntas.explica: A daily radar loses its meaning when it's out of time. A missed run stays missed; the next one comes at its scheduled time.
